Package de.juniorjacki.remotebrick.devices

Class Motor.MotorControl

java.lang.Object
de.juniorjacki.remotebrick.devices.Motor.MotorControl
Enclosing class:
Motor
public class Motor.MotorControl extends Object
Provides control commands for the motor.

All methods return a Command that can be executed in Thread or Async. Commands are only generated if the motor is functional.

  • Method Details

    • runForDegrees

      public MotorCommand runForDegrees(int speed, int degrees, boolean stall, StopType stopType, int acceleration, int deceleration)
      Runs the motor for a specified number of degrees.

      The motor rotates at the given speed until the target degree count is reached. Stall detection can be enabled, and stop behavior, acceleration, and deceleration can be precisely controlled.

      Parameter Ranges:

      • speed: -100 to 100 (percent; positive = forward, negative = backward)
      • degrees: Integer value (no strict max; limited by encoder precision ~0.1°)
      • stall: true to enable stall detection (motor stops if stalled, e.g., high torque and zero speed)
      • stopType: Type of stop action after reaching the position (e.g., COAST, BRAKE, HOLD). See StopType.
      • acceleration: 0 to 100 (percent of max acceleration per second; 0 = instant)
      • deceleration: 0 to 100 (percent of max deceleration per second; 0 = instant)
      Parameters:
      speed - Motor speed in percent (-100 to 100). Positive values = forward, negative = backward.
      degrees - Number of degrees the motor should rotate.
      stall - true to enable stall detection (motor stops if blocked).
      stopType - Type of stop action after reaching the position. See StopType.
      acceleration - Acceleration rate in percent per second (0 = instant).
      deceleration - Deceleration rate in percent per second (0 = instant).
      Returns:
      An executable Command object, or null if the motor is not functional.
      See Also:
      • StopType

    • runTimed

      public Command runTimed(int speed, long time, boolean stall, StopType stopType, int acceleration, int deceleration)
      Runs the motor for a specified duration in milliseconds.

      The motor operates at the given speed for the defined time period. Supports stall detection and customizable stop behavior.

      Parameter Ranges:

      • speed: -100 to 100 (percent)
      • time: Positive long value in ms (practical max ~86,400,000 ms/day)
      • stall: true to enable stall detection
      • stopType: See StopType (e.g., COAST: free spin, BRAKE: active stop, HOLD: maintain position)
      • acceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s)
      • deceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s)
      Parameters:
      speed - Motor speed in percent (-100 to 100).
      time - Duration in milliseconds to run the motor.
      stall - true to enable stall detection.
      stopType - Stop action after time expires. See StopType.
      acceleration - Acceleration rate in percent per second.
      deceleration - Deceleration rate in percent per second.
      Returns:
      An executable Command, or null if not functional.
      See Also:
      • StopType

    • start

      public MotorCommand start(int speed, boolean stall, int acceleration)
      Starts the motor at a constant speed without a stopping condition.

      The motor runs indefinitely until stop(StopType, int) is called.

      Parameter Ranges:

      • speed: -100 to 100 (%)
      • stall: true to enable stall detection
      • acceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s)
      Parameters:
      speed - Motor speed in percent (-100 to 100).
      stall - true to enable stall detection.
      acceleration - Acceleration rate in percent per second.
      Returns:
      An executable Command, or null if not functional.

    • stop

      public MotorCommand stop(StopType stopType, int deceleration)
      Stops the motor with the specified stop behavior and deceleration.

      Supported stop types: COAST (freewheel), BRAKE (active resistance), HOLD (maintain position with power).

      Parameter Ranges:

      • stopType: Enum value from StopType
      • deceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s; 0 = instant stop)
      Parameters:
      stopType - Type of stop action. See StopType.
      deceleration - Deceleration rate in percent per second (0 = instant).
      Returns:
      An executable Command, or null if not functional.
      See Also:
      • StopType

    • setPosition

      public Command setPosition(int offset)
      Resets or sets the motor's current position (encoder offset).

      This defines the zero point for relative position.

      Parameter Ranges:

      • offset: Integer degrees (no max; wraps at 360° for absolute, but tracks cumulatively)
      Parameters:
      offset - New position offset in degrees.
      Returns:
      An executable Command, or null if not functional.

      public MotorCommand goToRelativePosition(int position, int speed, boolean stall, StopType stopType, int acceleration, int deceleration)
      Moves the motor to a relative position from the current location.

      Target is relative to current encoder position.

      Parameter Ranges:

      • position: Integer degrees relative
      • speed: -100 to 100 (%)

      • acceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s)
      • deceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s)
      Parameters:

      speed - Motor speed in percent.
      stall - true to enable stall detection.
      stopType - Stop behavior on arrival. See StopType.
      acceleration - Acceleration rate.
      deceleration - Deceleration rate.
      Returns:
      An executable Command, or null if not functional.
      See Also:
      • StopType

    • goToPositionWithDirection

      public MotorCommand goToPositionWithDirection(int targetPosition, int speed, PathDirection direction, boolean stall, StopType stopType, int acceleration, int deceleration)
      Moves the motor to an absolute position with explicit direction control.

      Allows specifying whether to take the shortest path or force a direction.

      Parameter Ranges:

      • position: Integer absolute degrees
      • speed: -100 to 100 (%)
      • direction: Enum from PathDirection (e.g., CLOCKWISE, COUNTERCLOCKWISE, SHORTEST)
      • stall: true to enable
      • stopType: See StopType
      • acceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s)
      • deceleration: 0 to 100 (%/s)
      Parameters:
      targetPosition - Absolute target position in degrees.
      speed - Motor speed in percent.
      direction - Forced rotation direction. See PathDirection.
      stall - true to enable stall detection.
      stopType - Stop behavior on arrival. See StopType.
      acceleration - Acceleration rate.
      deceleration - Deceleration rate.
      Returns:
      An executable Command, or null if not functional.
      See Also:
      • PathDirection
      • StopType
